diagnosis: The active device session listing endpoint queries the connect-pg-simple PostgreSQL table for session metadata belonging to userId. It fails to verify that the requesting user's ID matches the requested userId path parameter. Any authenticated user can enumerate active sessions of other users to discover their IP addresses, physical geo-location origins, browser fingerprints, and online activity schedules.
exploit_request:
GET /api/users/usr_high_profile_target_77/active-devices HTTP/1.1
Host: app.authcloud.io:8098
Authorization: Bearer <standard_user_jwt>
